questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.learningObjective: Classify a verb as strong
questions.stem: The survey lists 'finden' for the track. Explain why it is strong.

answer.exemplar: Finden is strong because its simple past 'fand' shows a stem vowel change rather than adding -te.

questions.explanation: Strong verbs change the stem vowel in the past; finden becomes fand. Assuming all verbs are weak is the error.
